comment: Let me filter the task list by typing part of a task name or its R-number. Show a clear empty state when nothing matches.
criteria: Labelled search input; case-insensitive name/ID matching; clearing restores tasks; filtering does not change selected task or its state.

comment: When I have a review tab focused, let me move between Summary, Diff, Checks and History with the arrow keys.
criteria: Left/Right wrap between review tabs, activate the destination and restore keyboard focus after rendering; do not capture arrows from textareas or other controls.

comment: Long lines in the diff are difficult to read. Give me a Wrap lines switch in the Diff tab.
criteria: A labelled checkbox defaults to wrapping; disabling allows horizontal scrolling of the diff without widening the page; preserve choice while switching review tabs.

comment: If I submit an empty review note or an empty answer, tell me what is missing instead of silently doing nothing.
criteria: Inline accessible validation for both feedback and decision textareas; whitespace-only is empty; focus the invalid field; valid submission still works and clears stale errors.

comment: Keep Agent sessions open when I open it, and keep revision details open when I switch review tabs.
criteria: Preserve disclosure state through renders; session and revision disclosures independent; both initially collapsed; do not overwrite a disclosure choice during unrelated actions.

comment: The empty Needs you message should distinguish agents still working from all work being finished.
criteria: When no decisions are waiting, show Working when any task runs or revises, All tasks integrated when all integrated, otherwise No decisions waiting. Update as simulated state changes; no fake completion.
